newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico sees 10 pct real increase in tax collection.
newsitem.headline: Mexico sees 10 pct real increase in tax collection.

text.p: The Mexican Finance Ministry predicts the country will take in 10 percent more in taxes in real terms in 1997 over last year, Tomas Ruiz, the deputy minister for taxes, said on Wednesday.
"We are foreseeing an increase in tax revenue of around 10 percent in real terms for 1997," Ruiz told reporters at the annual conference of the Mexican Institute of Finance Executives.
"Insofar as the goverment does not collect these revenues, we would have to alter certain mechanisms that in the long- and medium-term would spoil the economic recovery," he said.
The Finance Ministry has launched a major publicity campaign against tax evasion and has taken legal action against celebrities and high-profile business people accused of not paying taxes.
